Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment (PXD017524) specifically analyzes proteins interacting with TRAF4 during the process of adipogenic differentiation induced by a cocktail of ligands (insulin, dexamethasone, etc.).
